comparison.objective: Take an ear temperature with a covered probe; candidate assembles an ER32 collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Anatomical-axis probe insertion and submillimetric stillness through measurement versus bimanual rigid-part alignment and snap seating.
comparison.success_condition: Valid reading followed by safe probe removal and stable placement versus retained collet passing a withdrawal check.
comparison.reason: Insertion is the only generic shared primitive; contact geometry, action sequence, hazards, and outcomes differ.
